_note: Files frozen by tests/fixtures/assess-request-path.sha256 before the move into src/translate and src/evaluation (pins = d8b2d12 blobs). Each moved file in "files" must equal its pin after the rename map is reversed. Never edit a pin. A file that later changes on purpose leaves "files" in that commit and is listed in "pinned_without_move" with the reason: the manifest pins its current bytes, and the request goldens and scripts/check_assess_resume.py prove the request bytes did not change. assess_checks.py left the freeze in the commit that made the leak check method-independent (it builds no request bytes). When the judge prompts moved into config files, the request text left the code: it now lives in the legacy prompt and config files, which are pinned here.

pinned_without_move.configs/evaluation/assess-legacy.yaml: the legacy judge config (rubric pilot-2) of the paid assess run; byte-identical criteria, scale and judge settings to the moved assess.yaml
pinned_without_move.configs/evaluation/prompts/assess-judge-: every word of the paid assess request (system prompt, rating rule, packet template and blocks), byte-identical to the former in-code prompt
pinned_without_move.src/evaluation/assess_judge.py: prompt texts moved into configs/evaluation/prompts/assess-judge-v2.yaml; renders material into the prompt file
pinned_without_move.src/evaluation/assess_data.py: loads the prompt file named by the config
pinned_without_move.src/evaluation/assess_cli.py: records the prompt file and refuses to re-judge an event with other request bytes
pinned_without_move.src/evaluation/prompt_files.py: loads and checks the prompt file and fills its templates
pinned_without_move.src/evaluation/strict_yaml.py: parses the prompt file and the judge config (duplicate keys rejected)
